headline: RESCENE's first solo concert tickets open Dec 10
sub: 'NOTES : BLOOMING' runs Feb 19–21, 2027 at Olympic Hall in Seoul

points.title: What to know
items: Fan club presale is for REMINE members
Up to 2 tickets per person per show
One device per Coupang WOW account
Photo ID check and non-transferable wristbands

source: Source: Coupang Play via Korean media
caption:
Tickets for RESCENE's first-ever solo concert open on Dec 10!

'2027 RESCENE CONCERT IN SEOUL <NOTES : BLOOMING>' runs Feb 19–21, 2027 at Olympic Hall in Seoul. The fan club presale opens Dec 10 at 8 PM KST, followed by general sale on Dec 11 at 8 PM KST, only on the Coupang Play app. To stop scalpers, each person can buy up to 2 tickets per show, and fans will need photo ID and a non-transferable wristband to get in.

📌 Source: Coupang Play, via Korean media (ZDNet Korea, Top Star News)
